name: Using generation to solve problems
gist: Papers that use generative models to answer difficult questions or fix broken data, including solving math problems, restoring damaged images, and improving data quality.
explain: Beyond creating pretty outputs for their own sake, generative models can solve hard problems. If you have a model that learned the structure of valid solutions (images, proteins, code, proofs), you can use it as a tool: point it at a broken or incomplete thing, and have it imagine what should go there. Inpainting is the simplest example—'I have a photo with someone's face blurred; generate what that face should look like.' Image restoration means 'this photo is noisy or corrupted; clean it up.' Molecule design means 'generate new molecules that would bind to this protein' (critical for drug discovery). Mathematical reasoning means using generation to search through possible proofs of a theorem.

The challenge is that these aren't straightforward generation tasks. When you inpaint a blurred face, you can't just generate any face—it has to match the context, the lighting, the angle, the person's actual appearance if visible elsewhere. The model has to navigate a constrained space: 'generate something that looks realistic AND fits the context AND solves the problem.' For molecules, the model has to generate structures that actually follow chemistry rules and have the desired properties. For proofs, it has to generate steps that are logically valid.

Researchers handle these constraints in several ways. Conditional generation means feeding extra information (the image context, the target properties) into the model to guide it. Iterative refinement means generating a rough solution, checking if it works, and then refining it. Some papers use a generative model as one part of a larger system—it generates candidates, and a separate tool checks if they're valid or useful. For molecules, researchers combine generative models with chemical constraints and simulators that check if a generated molecule would actually work. The key is treating the generative model as part of a problem-solving pipeline, not a standalone system.

papers.title: TangoFlux: Super Fast and Faithful Text to Audio Generation with Flow Matching and Clap-Ranked Preference Optimization
papers.contribution: The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on objective and subjective benchmarks through flow matching and CLAP-ranked preference optimization.

papers.title: Unveiling And Addressing Dimensional Collapse In Vector Quantization Models Via Codebook Regularization
papers.contribution: Regularization improves reconstruction fidelity and downstream performance in autoregressive image generative models across diverse VQ training paradigms.

papers.title: Value Matching: Scalable and Gradient-Free Reward-Guided Flow Adaptation
papers.contribution: Value Matching achieves comparable performance to full fine-tuning methods while requiring less than 5% of their memory usage, with improved stability and sample efficiency.

papers.title: Benchmarking and Evolving Reason-Reflect-Rectify for Reflective Visual Generation
papers.contribution: The method achieves +12.0% in reflective verdict score and +9.0% in rectification score on R³-Bench, seamlessly integrating with various MLLMs.

papers.title: BideDPO: Conditional Image Generation with Simultaneous Text and Condition Alignment
papers.contribution: Enables nuanced case-by-case trade-offs for multi-constraint image generation via bidirectionally decoupled DPO with iterative optimization.

papers.title: Consis-GCPO: Consistency-Preserving Group Causal Preference Optimization for Vision Customization
papers.contribution: Significantly advances personalized generation with superior subject consistency while preserving text-following, excelling in complex multi-subject scenarios.

papers.title: Efficient Tail-Aware Generative Optimization via Flow Model Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Enables efficient tail-aware distributional fine-tuning comparable in cost to standard fine-tuning while controlling worst-case and discovering high-reward samples.

papers.title: Embedding-perturbed Exploration Preference Optimization for Flow Models
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines achieving more faithful alignment with human preference through preservation of variance in training.

papers.title: Flow Expansion via Verifier-Constrained Noised State Space Exploration
papers.contribution: FE provably expands pre-trained flow models beyond regions of high data availability while preserving sample validity, demonstrated on molecular design with increased conformer diversity.

papers.title: Follow-Your-Preference: Towards Preference-Aligned Image Inpainting
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that reward model ensembles mitigate individual biases and significantly outperform prior models across standard metrics and human evaluations without structural changes.

papers.title: Generative Universal Verifier as Multimodal Meta-Reasoner
papers.contribution: Demonstrates three atomic capabilities in visual verification that generalize synergistically; achieves +8.3 on ViVerBench, +3.7 on T2I-ReasonBench, +4.3 on GenEval++.

papers.title: GuidedSampling: Steering LLMs Towards Diverse Candidate Solutions at Inference-Time
papers.contribution: Improves pass@50 by approximately 21.6% across benchmarks compared to repeated sampling, and models trained on GuidedSampling trajectories improve pass@5 by approximately 9.7%.

papers.title: JavisDiT++: Unified Modeling and Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on 1M public training entries, significantly outperforming prior approaches in quality, consistency, and synchrony.

papers.title: Meta Flow Maps enable scalable reward alignment
papers.contribution: Single-particle steered-MFM outperforms Best-of-1000 baseline across multiple ImageNet rewards at a fraction of the compute.

papers.title: Neural Dispersion on Graphs
papers.contribution: The method produces high diversity while scaling N and k an order of magnitude beyond prior work without distribution fitting or per-metric retraining.

papers.title: Offline Preference Optimization for Rectified Flow with Noise-Tracked Pairs
papers.contribution: Consistently improves preference metrics on state-of-the-art rectified flow T2I models while substantially reducing training compute through dynamic regularization.

papers.title: OmniText: A Training-Free Generalist for Controllable Text-Image Manipulation
papers.contribution: Training-free generalist for diverse text image manipulation tasks with novel loss functions and OmniText-Bench dataset for evaluation.

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Models for Generation and Inverse Problems
papers.contribution: We validate our method on canonical PDE problems, demonstrating improved satisfaction of physical constraints and accurate recovery of latent coefficients.

papers.title: PosterCraft: Rethinking High-Quality Aesthetic Poster Generation in a Unified Framework
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms open-source baselines in rendering, layout, and visual appeal, approaching commercial system quality.

papers.title: Routing by Reaching: Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation
papers.contribution: Framework achieves performance comparable to baselines on molecule generation while enabling rapid adaptation to new objective sets; exactly recovers target for linear scalarization.

papers.title: Scalable Training for Vector-Quantized Networks with 100% Codebook Utilization
papers.contribution: Achieves 100% codebook usage even with 262k-codebook, attains state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, and when integrated with LlamaGen surpasses visual autoregressive models by 0.5 rFID and diffusion models by 0.2 rFID.

papers.title: Scaling Group Inference for Diverse and High-Quality Generation
papers.contribution: The method significantly improves group diversity and quality compared to independent sampling and recent inference algorithms across text-to-image, image-to-image, and image prompting tasks.

papers.title: Score Correction for Generative Models with Probabilistic Constraints
papers.contribution: DualScore enables constraint satisfaction in pretrained image diffusion models without retraining, demonstrated on fairness and regularized maximum likelihood estimation.

papers.title: TPGDiff : Hierarchical Triple-Prior Guided Diffusion for Image Restoration
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance and generalization across diverse restoration scenarios on both single- and multi-degradation benchmarks.

papers.title: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
papers.contribution: Flow-TTRL elevates Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium accuracy from 63% to 87% and Flux.1 Dev from 66% to 83% on GenEval, with 15-20% gains across T2I-CompBench without fine-tuning.

papers.title: Unifying Heterogeneous Degradations: Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Bridge Model for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse restoration tasks within a single inference step.

papers.title: ViPO: Visual Preference Optimization at Scale
papers.contribution: Optimal configuration converges to standard DPO with high-quality data, validating both dataset quality and Poly-DPO's adaptive nature.

papers.title: VisualScore: Learning Holistic Visual Quality Scores via Multi-Task Reasoning
papers.contribution: Improves robustness, generalization, and interpretability across technical quality, aesthetic quality, and text-image alignment tasks without test-time retraining.
